<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"45f89244670fec0d816619433e702cedbcda43c39d58cb7dfc89be8e771fb486"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — serienstream.to episode pages load popunder ad tags (al5sm.com, nap5k.com — already blocked at baseline) and the site itself announces 4-6 ad pop-ups per video, matching the reporter's clicking-to-play pop-ups; but the play flow sits behind an ALTCHA/Cloudflare verification modal whose submit no tool may perform, so no pop-up could be rehearsed (popupsOpened 0 in every apply_rule phase) and the candidate stayed browser-unverified. Carried for a human:⁠ extend the site family's existing shared scriptlet to the reported domain — serienstream.to,s.to,serienstream.sx#⁠%#⁠//scriptlet('prevent-addEventListener', 'click', 'window.open') in BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt.

## Candidate for review

`serienstream.to,s.to,serienstream.sx#%#//scriptlet('prevent-addEventListener', 'click', 'window.open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: Pop-up behaviour could not be reproduced or measured. Clicking a playback server only opens the site's 'Video wird vorbereitet...' ALTCHA/Cloudflare verification modal, and the form submit that would load the stream is refused by the interaction tool, so the step that spawns the pop-ups is unreachable; rehearsals reported popupsOpened:⁠ 0. apply_rule was inconclusive with failedCandidateChecks empty - its pixel review called the verification gate and empty player 'remaining' (symptom not_resolved), which a screenshot cannot judge for a tab-opening defect - and the corrected-revealSteps rerun was skipped (baseline_symptom_absent). Full-page vision confirmed the page but classified an anti-bot challenge. 2 candidate attempts remain.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/41938064155

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `7175c75`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>
